answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each id earn weight through work, not copies. A fresh id enters the ledger as an inlet, carrying only a single drop of influence, and must publish signed, replayable task proofs that peers rerun. Attesters stake collateral and forfeit it if they vouch for a fake, so endorsement is never free. Reputation accumulates like sediment building a delta, while cloned wallets stay as inert as umber mud, weightless and unproven.
